resampling: Original only; no RUS/SMOTE in this explicitly separate pilot
primary_split: per-source-PCAP packet-index 60% A,10% G,10% C,20% V; first1s of each role excluded from labeled decisions; context reset at each boundary
clock: Arrival-order causal watermark=max(previous clock,packet timestamp); no sorting or future packets
identity: Selected development packets matched by minute/second/nanoseconds, IP endpoints, TCP checksum/ports/payload length; inferred hour offset and year verified; any multiple match/unmatched stops fit
secondary_protocol: two nonport25 signature-disjoint diagnostic folds, seed42; expert/gate/calibration drawn only inside outer training; shared label-free causal context not capture-independent
novelty_status: First feasibility and selective-computation prototype; not a claimed new active acquisition algorithm
number_status: Research defaults, not numerical requirements endorsed by supervisor or papers
identity_alias_rule: Repeated candidates allowed only for identical full packet bytes AND absolute timestamp AND header/behavior vector. Otherwise stop. Assign alias to latest role without labels; require every alias to pass purge.
